m920226.甘すぎて、気持ち悪い……おえぇ……。: It's too sweet… it's making me sick… ugh…

m920226.砂糖を混ぜた途端に苦しみはじめた……！？: She started suffering the moment we mixed in the sugar……!?
m920226.私が美味しそうに見えすぎてるからかな……？: Maybe it's because I look too delicious...?

If you had just asked me,
I could have suggested a much safer transport route.

I am a cacao bean!
I came here because I wanted everyone to eat me!

Eat meeee—!!
Everyone wants chocolate, right—!!

Eat me. And be dominated by me.

m920226.給料をチョコ払いにすることで人件費を大幅に削減！\nこれぞ私の、完璧なバレンタイ:
Paying wages in chocolate drastically cuts labor costs!

I'll just say that we're doing this
so no one gets in trouble with the law.

Something that looks like brown beans is marching through the town

m920226.街を直したり、人々の手当てをしたりと、\n後処理は必要になるだろうが、\n事態は:
There will be plenty of cleanup, like repairing the town

and crushed and ground with tremendous force.

Even though they're from the Demon World,

m920226.魔界カカオの木は成長するほどに、\n周囲のカカオたちに力を与えてしまう。\n実が:
The Demon World cacao trees grant power

It's best to defeat them before they bear fruit.

It seems the Demon World cacao has calmed down.
